visualCharacteristics.summary: Two side-by-side panels: newsletter signup (heading, description, email field, consent checkbox, Subscribe) and Archives (Year and Month selects, Submit).

contentPattern.structure: Row 1 (newsletter): heading + description paragraph, optional consent paragraph, optional link whose text is the button label and href the POST endpoint. Row 2 (archives; detected by "Archive" in the heading): heading, optional link to the archive listing page (text = button label; year/month sent as ?year=&month=), optional 4-digit earliest year.
